hero.headline: Your ticket, ready before you arrive.
hero.support: Discover events, reserve your spot, and show up with everything sorted.

about.headline: Clear events. Tickets without the fuss.
about.body: {appNameDisplay} brings venues and audiences together: real dates, understandable tickets, and a clean interface so you can decide with confidence.
about.imageAlt: Lit stage during a live show

atmosphere.quote: Less confusion. More reason to go.
atmosphere.support: Clear tickets, real dates, and a schedule you can read in seconds — before you leave home.
atmosphere.imageAlt: Crowd with hands in the air at a show

1.title: Create your account
1.body: Register once. After that, every event is one tap away.

2.title: Pick the event
2.body: Browse dates, venues, and tickets with the information that matters.

3.title: Ticket ready
3.body: Buy, confirm, and arrive knowing your place is already set.

clarity.headline: Ticket, door, and schedule — no fine print.
clarity.support: What you need to decide and arrive, up front.

ticket.title: Clear tickets
ticket.body: Type, price, and availability in one place. No surprises in line.

secure.title: QR ready at the door
secure.body: Clear confirmation and a code ready when you arrive. Less friction at entry.

time.title: Dates you can scan fast
time.body: Times and venues in view — while there’s still room.

pulse.headline: For the event you want to live.
pulse.body: {appNameDisplay} doesn’t invent the experience — it organizes it. Discover, choose, and secure your place without losing the rhythm.
pulse.imageAlt: Crowd hands raised in front of the stage

events.headline: The schedule isn’t open yet
events.support: When events go live, they’ll live here. Create your account so you’re ready the day the first date drops.
events.previewAria: Live-event atmosphere — no published dates yet

2.imageAlt: Crowd at a festival under colored lights

closing.headline: Your next event starts here.
closing.support: Create your account and come back when the full schedule opens.

organizers.headline: Publish venues, events, and tickets.
organizers.support: Repo’s panel is for owners and staff: create venues, build the schedule, and sell tickets without the noise.
organizers.hint: Opens the organizer panel in another tab.

footer.publishBody: Manage venues, events, and tickets from the panel.
footer.madeFor: Made so you can enjoy every event with peace of mind.

signOutDialog.title: Sign out
